rows.final_code:
integer n, i, j, k, x, y, bin
integer fb(3), ord(3)
double precision v(3), lo(3), hi(3)

lo(1) = 376.044d0
hi(1) = 517.376d0
fb(1) = 33
lo(2) = 107.095d0
hi(2) = 159.905d0
fb(2) = 30
lo(3) = 12.444d0
hi(3) = 19.156d0
fb(3) = 32

# priority order: VDD (3), FMAX (2), IDDQ (1)
ord(1) = 3
ord(2) = 2
ord(3) = 1

read(5,*) n
do i = 1, n {
  read(5,*) x, y, v(1), v(2), v(3)
  bin = 0
  do k = 1, 3 {
    if (bin == 0) {
      j = ord(k)
      if (v(j) == -9999d0) bin = 26
      else if (v(j) < lo(j) | v(j) > hi(j)) bin = fb(j)
    }
  }
  if (bin == 0) {
    bin = 1
    do j = 1, 3 {
      if (abs(v(j) - lo(j)) <= 0.02d0 * abs(lo(j))) bin = 15
      if (abs(v(j) - hi(j)) <= 0.02d0 * abs(hi(j))) bin = 15
    }
  }
  write(6,*) x, y, bin
}
end

integer n, i, x, y, bin, marg
double precision g, r, gv, rv
read(5,*) n
do i = 1, n {
  read(5,*) x, y, g, r
  # work in exact integer thousandths (stored as double)
  gv = dnint(g*1000d0)
  rv = dnint(r*1000d0)
  bin = 0
  # priority 1: RDS (skip if not measured)
  if (r != -9999d0) if (rv < 168985d0 | rv > 245607d0) bin = 4
  # priority 2: GAIN (bin 2 if not measured)
  if (bin == 0) if (g == -9999d0) bin = 2
  if (bin == 0) if (g != -9999d0) if (gv < 141092d0 | gv > 178908d0) bin = 18
  # marginal check: within 10% of a limit (inclusive)
  if (bin == 0) {
    marg = 0
    if (r != -9999d0) {
      if (dabs(rv - 168985d0)*10d0 <= 168985d0) marg = 1
      if (dabs(rv - 245607d0)*10d0 <= 245607d0) marg = 1
    }
    if (g != -9999d0) {
      if (dabs(gv - 141092d0)*10d0 <= 141092d0) marg = 1
      if (dabs(gv - 178908d0)*10d0 <= 178908d0) marg = 1
    }
    bin = 1
    if (marg == 1) bin = 11
  }
  write(6,*) x, y, bin
}
end

integer n, i, bin, marg, x, y
double precision fmax, vth, temp, vdd

read(5,*) n
for (i = 1; i <= n; i = i + 1) {
  read(5,*) x, y, fmax, vth, temp, vdd
  bin = 0

  # priority 1: VTH, low 224.154, high 341.646, fail bin 36, not measured -> bin 5
  if (vth == -9999d0) bin = 5
  if (bin == 0 & (vth < 224.154d0 | vth > 341.646d0)) bin = 36

  # priority 2: FMAX, high 224.619, fail bin 6, not measured -> skip
  if (bin == 0 & fmax != -9999d0 & fmax > 224.619d0) bin = 6

  # priority 3: TEMP, low 186.357, high 210.843, fail bin 8, not measured -> skip
  if (bin == 0 & temp != -9999d0 & (temp < 186.357d0 | temp > 210.843d0)) bin = 8

  # priority 4: VDD, low 58.608, high 86.592, fail bin 25, not measured -> skip
  if (bin == 0 & vdd != -9999d0 & (vdd < 58.608d0 | vdd > 86.592d0)) bin = 25

  # no test failed: check marginality (within 2% of any own limit)
  if (bin == 0) {
    marg = 0
    if (abs(vth - 224.154d0) <= 0.02d0*abs(224.154d0) | abs(vth - 341.646d0) <= 0.02d0*abs(341.646d0)) marg = 1
    if (abs(fmax - 224.619d0) <= 0.02d0*abs(224.619d0)) marg = 1
    if (abs(temp - 186.357d0) <= 0.02d0*abs(186.357d0) | abs(temp - 210.843d0) <= 0.02d0*abs(210.843d0)) marg = 1
    if (abs(vdd - 58.608d0) <= 0.02d0*abs(58.608d0) | abs(vdd - 86.592d0) <= 0.02d0*abs(86.592d0)) marg = 1
    if (marg == 1) bin = 34
    else bin = 1
  }

  write(6,*) x, y, bin
}
end
